section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar for Shabbos Nitzavim-Vayeilech, 23 Elul 5739.
section.t: "With the help of Heaven."
Shabbos Parshas Nitzavim-Vayeilech,

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the unity of all Jews on Rosh Hashanah, as indicated by the verse "You are standing today," is the vessel for drawing down the life-force for the entire year.
section.t: "You are standing today, all of you, before Hashem your G-d: your heads, your tribes... from the hewer of your wood to the drawer of your water."1
And it is brought in Likkutei Torah2
that this portion is always read before Rosh Hashanah,3
and it is hinted in the word "today" which refers to Rosh Hashanah,4
for this5
day is the beginning of Your works, a remembrance of the first day.
And this is the meaning of "You are standing today, all of you,"
that all of the children of Israel, from your heads, your tribes, etc., down to the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water, are united together to be as one,6
for the vessel for the blessings and effluences from above is the matter of unity,
as it is said,7
"Bless us, our Father,"
(as)
all of us as one specifically
(as explained at length in Tanya, chapter 32,
Likkutei Torah, discourse "Hachaltzu,"8
and in Sefer HaMitzvos of the Tzemach Tzedek, the commandment of Ahavas Yisrael).
And since on Rosh Hashanah the life-force for the entire year is drawn down,
as is known
(and explained at length in the Sefer HaArachim of the Tzemach Tzedek,9
and hinted at in Likkutei Torah10)
that it is called Rosh Hashanah
(and not the beginning of the year)
because it is analogous to the head, which includes within itself all the limbs of the body,
and also, just as the limbs are in their place, the head is found within them, and it even governs them
(for all the limbs obey its will),
so too is it with the day of Rosh Hashanah,
that on it all the life-force of all the days of the year is drawn down,
and also their conduct afterward is according to the manner of their drawing down on Rosh Hashanah
(and so too is it in the service of man,
that his conduct throughout all the days of the year is according to the manner of the decisions made on Rosh Hashanah).
And this is "You are standing today, all of you,"
for the preparation and vessel for this effluence is "all of you,"
the unification of the children of Israel to be as one,
through which they become vessels for the indwelling of His Oneness, blessed be He.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ten levels of the Jewish people, from the highest to the lowest, unite as "one" (echad) to become a private domain for the revelation of the level of "yechidah" and Atzmus.
section.t: And the verse specifies ten levels
("your heads, your tribes... from the hewer of your wood to the drawer of your water"),
just as there are ten levels in the soul of man, namely three intellects and seven emotions,
so too all of Israel are one complete structure that is divided into ten levels.11
And the explanation is,
that the unity of the children of Israel, that they are united to be as one, through which they become vessels for the indwelling of His Oneness, blessed be He,
is not in a manner that there are no distinctions of levels among them
(nor even that from the revelation of the aspect of Yechidah they are nullified from their existence),
but rather,
that even as they are in a state of existence and are divided into ten levels,
nevertheless they are united with a complete unity.
For this unity
(the unity of individual parts)
is like the unity of the aspect of Echad
(which is below the aspect of Yechidah).
And as is known12
the difference between Echad and Yechidah,
that Yechidah is above division, whereas Echad is that there exist things that are divided, except that they become united.
And as is also hinted in the letters of the word Echad,
that the Chet and Dalet allude to the seven firmaments and the earth and the four directions of the world,13
and they are nullified to the Alef.
And the Alef does not negate the existence of the world,
for the Alef itself means the Aluf (Master) of the world,13
and the Alef is the head of the word Echad that includes14
(as above regarding the matter of "head")
the Chet
(seven firmaments and earth)
and the Dalet
(four directions of the world),
and through this unity of the children of Israel
[who are in a state of existence and are divided into ten levels, and together upon this they are as one]
they become a private domain for His Oneness, blessed be He,
that is, for the aspect of Yechidah
(which is above the aspect of Echad),15
the revelation of the aspect of Yechidah that is drawn down into the aspect of the Living One of the worlds, the King,
and even to the existence and division of the levels,16
down to the level of the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water.
And on the contrary,
through the unity of the children of Israel, even as they are divided into ten levels down to the level of the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water,
through this they become one with His very Essence (Atzmus), blessed be He.
